segments.title: 1. Intro & Polite Apology for Using TTS
segments.text: Hello Meta and Cerebral Valley judges! My name is Doan Minh Tri, an indie developer from Vietnam. First, please accept my sincere apologies: because my spoken English is not very fluent yet, I kindly ask for your permission to use AI Text-to-Speech so I can present my project clearly within the three-minute limit. Today, I am excited to introduce Hoc Bong Hunter version 4.0 — an open-source, 12-node multi-agent scholarship ecosystem powered by Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 and Muse Spark 1.3.

segments.title: 2. Problem Statement, 50 Languages & QuotaGuard Security
segments.text: Every year, millions of students miss out on life-changing international scholarships because portals are scattered across languages, commercial agencies charge thousands of dollars, and standard LLMs often hallucinate expired deadlines or fake links. To solve this for students worldwide, Hoc Bong Hunter supports 50 global languages with automatic right-to-left layout, Light and Dark themes, and five free sponsored live API runs per IP and device MAC address via our QuotaGuard security engine.

segments.title: 3. AI CV Parser, 1-Click Presets & 5-Axis SVG Radar Chart
segments.text: Let's see how it works in real time. A student can either paste their raw resume into our AI CV Parser powered by Muse Spark 1.3, or select a one-click student preset. Immediately, Node 1 analyzes their academic profile and renders a live 5-Axis SVG Radar Chart, comparing their GPA, IELTS score, and research experience against a Full Scholarship Benchmark.

segments.title: 4. 12-Node Pipeline & Muse Wonder 1.0 + Spark 1.3 Routing
segments.text: Now, when we trigger the 12-node pipeline, our Heterogeneous Router pairs Meta's newest models over the official v1 responses API. Node 2, powered by Muse Wonder 1.0, acts as the Supervisor and designs a three-lane search strategy. It then fans out to three parallel Muse Spark 1.3 Researcher agents executing concurrent web searches. Clicking any node on our interactive SVG flowchart opens the live Telemetry Inspector — showing the exact input prompt, JSON output, model ID, token usage, latency, and USD cost.

segments.title: 5. Triple-Verification Protocol & Side-by-Side Comparison
segments.text: To completely eliminate AI hallucinations, Node 8 runs our Triple-Verification Engine. Using Muse Wonder 1.0 in a fresh context window alongside deterministic checks, it audits official dot-gov and dot-edu domains, validates 2026 to 2027 deadlines, and cross-checks GPA and language requirements to compute a transparent Trust Score up to 99 percent. Students can also select multiple verified cards to compare them side-by-side.

segments.title: 6. AI Mock Interviewer (#11), Essay Critic (#12) & Calendar/PDF Export
segments.text: Finally, in our AI Application Studio, Muse Wonder 1.0 drafts a tailored Motivation Letter and a three-stage roadmap. Agent 11 serves as an AI Mock Interview Coach with voice recognition and STAR method grading, while Agent 12 acts as an AI Essay Critic that detects clichés and rewrites weak drafts into polished academic English. Students can export deadlines to Google or Apple Calendar via dot-ICS or print an A4 PDF report. Thank you Meta and Cerebral Valley for this incredible hackathon!
